title: Ankle Aids
description: Ankle supports, braces, foot drop splints, cast shoes, and DRB for ankle sprains, ligament injuries, and post-fracture rehabilitation.

products.name: Ankle Support
features: Elasticated neoprene sleeve for uniform ankle compression
Figure-of-eight stirrup straps add mediolateral stability
Low-profile design fits inside standard footwear
Non-slip inner surface keeps the support correctly positioned
benefits: Reduces ankle swelling and pain after ligament sprains
Provides proprioceptive feedback to improve balance and reduce re-sprain risk
Suitable for return to sport and daily activity after ankle injury
Retains warmth to relax ankle musculature and ease chronic stiffness

products.name: Anklet With Binder
features: Elasticated anklet combined with a wrap-around figure-of-eight binder
Provides both circumferential and cross-joint compression
Adjustable binder allows varying levels of support
Breathable construction suitable for extended daily wear
benefits: Delivers enhanced ankle stability for moderate sprains and chronic instability
Reduces swelling more effectively than a standard compression sleeve alone
Supports the ankle during rehabilitation exercises
Easy to apply and remove for patients with limited hand strength

products.name: Ankle Brace
features: Rigid stirrup side panels with cushioned bladder lining
Adjustable lace-up or velcro closure for a customised fit
Fits inside most lace-up footwear for use during activity
Contoured shell prevents inversion and eversion beyond safe ranges
benefits: Provides strong mediolateral ankle stability for moderate-to-severe sprains
Protects against ankle inversion injuries during sport and uneven-ground walking
Allows dorsiflexion and plantarflexion for functional walking
Reduces fear of re-injury, supporting confident return to activity

products.name: Foot Drop Splint
features: Lightweight thermoplastic posterior shell holds the ankle at 90°
Padded inner lining prevents pressure sores over bony prominences
Velcro straps secure the splint to the calf and foot
Low-profile heel allows use inside wide-fitting footwear
benefits: Maintains the foot in neutral dorsiflexion to prevent foot drop during walking
Prevents equinus contracture in patients with peroneal nerve palsy or stroke
Enables safer ambulation by reducing trip and fall risk
Used in neurological rehabilitation to support gait re-training

products.name: Cast Shoes
features: Rigid rocker sole protects the cast or boot during weight-bearing
Velcro instep strap accommodates the bulky circumference of a plaster cast
Non-slip sole surface improves grip on indoor and outdoor surfaces
Lightweight construction does not add significant weight to the limb
benefits: Protects plaster casts and post-operative dressings from wear and soiling
Allows weight-bearing ambulation during lower limb fracture recovery
Reduces cast breakdown at the heel and sole from walking
Improves patient independence and mobility during the casting period

products.name: DRB
features: Dynamic response design absorbs ground reaction forces
Adjustable dorsiflexion assist mechanism supports toe clearance during swing
Rigid uprights provide mediolateral ankle control
Compatible with standard footwear
benefits: Assists dynamic ankle function in patients with lower limb weakness
Reduces compensatory gait patterns that cause hip and knee pain
Supports safe ambulation during neurological and orthopaedic rehabilitation
Improves walking efficiency and reduces energy expenditure for the patient
